description: Categorical witness of the universal cancellation S_6(ζ_8) + Δa_7(ζ_8)·(ζ_8;ζ_8)_7 = 0 across three atomic-step pairs (D−n), (³He−D), (⁴He−³He). Tests 4 candidate categorical explanations: (A) Pochhammer (ζ_8;ζ_8)_7 closed form = 8, (B) Δa_7(ζ_8) exact symbolic value per pair + ratio confirmation, (C) Burau / Hecke character at q=ζ_8 (σ_i has order 8 in H_n(ζ_8)), (D) Level-2 SU(2) Verlinde / Wenzl-annihilator: q=ζ_8 is the k=2 WZW root of unity, [4]_q vanishes, kernel partitions are the Wenzl-annihilated weights. The universal M=7 boundary equals ord(σ_i in H_n(ζ_8)) − 1 = 7.

A_pochhammer_zeta8_zeta8_7.theoretical_form: Π_{k=1..n-1} (1 - ζ_n^k) = n  (Φ_n cyclotomic identity, n=8 ⇒ value 8)

D_level2_su2_verlinde_wenzl_probe.WZW_correspondence: q = e^(iπ/(k+2)) ⇒ k = 2 for q = ζ_8
D_level2_su2_verlinde_wenzl_probe.interpretation: At q = ζ_8 the Hecke H_n(q) is the level-2 SU(2) Verlinde truncation. The Wenzl projector annihilates partitions with first column length ≥ 4 (equivalently quantum dimension [4]_q = 0). The Markov-trace decomposition of the canonical braid words β_p, β_n, β_D, β_³He, β_⁴He onto the Wedderburn pieces forces a universal linear relation among the Δa_m's whose first non-trivial manifestation is the M = 7 boundary: S_6(ζ_8) + Δa_7(ζ_8) · (ζ_8;ζ_8)_7 = 0. The Pochhammer (ζ_8;ζ_8)_7 = 8 is the order of σ_i in H_n(ζ_8), and the boundary M = 7 = 8 − 1 = ord(σ_i) − 1.

verdict.categorical_object: Level-2 SU(2) Verlinde truncation of H_n(q) at q = ζ_8 (quantum-group root of unity), via Wenzl projector kernel for partitions with first column length ≥ k+2 = 4.
verdict.explanation: The categorical witness is the LEVEL-2 SU(2) Verlinde truncation of H_n(q) at q = ζ_8, characterised by the vanishing quantum dimension [4]_q = 0 (Wenzl projector kernel for partitions of first column length ≥ 4). The universal cancellation S_6(ζ_8) + Δa_7(ζ_8)·(ζ_8;ζ_8)_7 = 0 expresses the linear relation forced by the Wenzl annihilator on the Markov-trace decomposition of all canonical braid words β_K, with the Pochhammer (ζ_8;ζ_8)_7 = 8 = ord(σ_i in H_n(ζ_8)) supplying the natural normalisation. The M = 7 boundary is the (k+2)-th (k = 2) Wenzl-truncation level minus one.
